additional_concerns: The extraction's assertion that footnote 3 is missing is wrong: da12aecad4e68.u30.3569 states, "Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission." Its markers attach to XML and PDF, not the web-form option. The XML permission must retain this qualification.

The XML schema is required by da12aecad4e68.u14.2439 but is not supplied. The prescribed PDF specification and operational e-Cert requirements are also absent. The four declared missing dependencies have no descriptive mapping or bound source; their identities cannot be inferred.

The compliance candidates expressly exclude XML-schema conformity from their XML facts. Their results can establish only the selected channel, format and e-Cert control, not full XML submission compliance. Whether schema conformity belongs within the selected 'method' control remains unresolved.

The source requires an e-Cert but does not specify that it must be 'supplied or used for this particular' submission. node.e527b70be44a95d97a2e5ae5 must not turn that operational interpretation into an additional restriction without authority.

node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 includes the entire launch date. The source separately identifies a 9:00am launch and a blackout continuing until that time. Retain the date-based and operational-launch interpretations; the date comparison can trigger resubmission before operational launch.
The source does not expressly establish a timezone. The timestamp-based candidates require external timezone authority; supplied Boolean classifications do not resolve that legal interpretation.

Moving actual STR submission into scope produces OUT_OF_SCOPE for non-submission events, whereas node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb can return false. Confirm the assessment domain before treating those outcomes as equivalent.

The history candidate answers whether a triggering event ever occurred, not whether a resubmission duty remains outstanding. A later compliant resubmission does not erase the historical trigger. Its false result requires sufficient history, as its supplied fact definition recognizes.

Missing method details do not make the XML or web-form permissions executable requirements of the separate resubmission-trigger questions. These NOT_APPLICABLE proposals do not authorize pruning those claims from other controls.
